LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_TreasureSitePart.label: treasure cache
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_TreasureSitePart.descri: A prepared map of ruins, a vault or a looter camp. Guards, hidden rooms, traps and decoys may be present. Inspect clues and take your loot before leaving.
LanguageData.GrechkaTreasures_TreasureSitePart.arrive: Your caravan has arrived. Inspect the ruins carefully: valuable objects can be decoys, and side passages may be safer than the main entrance.
